tasks.original_prompt: Write a Python function `sum_even_values(values)` that returns the sum of the even integers in a list of integers. An empty list returns 0.
tasks.shifted_prompt: Implement `sum_even_values(sequence)`. Given a list of integers, produce the total of entries divisible by two; if it has no entries, produce zero.
tasks.semantic_invariant: For every list of integers, both prompts require the sum of exactly its even values.
tasks.reference_solution:
def sum_even_values(values):
    return sum(value for value in values if value % 2 == 0)

tasks.original_prompt: Write a Python function `normalize_whitespace(text)` that strips leading and trailing whitespace and replaces every internal run of whitespace with one space.
tasks.shifted_prompt: Create `normalize_whitespace(raw_text)`: remove outside spacing, then collapse each consecutive whitespace block between words to a single ordinary space.
tasks.semantic_invariant: For every string, both prompts return stripped text with each internal whitespace run represented by one space.
